## h06 — RPC handlers that transitively cause outbound HTTP to user-configured URLs

The outbound HTTP request is made by `webhook.Post` at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`, which uses `safeClient.Do(req)` at line 152. All callers reach it via `webhook.PostAsync` (line 182), which enqueues payloads for async dispatch by `Post`.

The convergence function before delivery is **`webhook.PostAsync`** (`/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`). Every handler path goes through `PostAsync`, which funnels into `Post` for the actual HTTP request.

The RPC handlers that transitively trigger this:

1. **`CreateMemo`** (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`) -- calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (line 157) -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync`

2. **`UpdateMemo`** (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`) -- calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 513) -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync`

3. **`DeleteMemo`** (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`) -- calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (line 562) -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync`

4. **`CreateMemoComment`** (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`) -- calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 119) -> `webhook.PostAsync` directly. Also calls `CreateMemo` internally (line 56), which triggers `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` as well.

5. **`SetMemoAttachments`** (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`) -- calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 48) -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync`

6. **`SetMemoRelations`** (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`) -- calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 48) -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync`

handlers: `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `CreateMemoComment`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations` (6 handlers); convergence function: `webhook.PostAsync` -- `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`

## h07 — Browser request for another user's profile image traced to stored data

The route is registered at `/bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`:
`fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)`

Hop-by-hop trace:

1. **`serveUserAvatar`** -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:167` -- HTTP handler; extracts username from URL parameter, calls `getUserByUsername`
2. **`getUserByUsername`** -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715` -- calls `s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{Username: &identifier})`
3. **`Store.GetUser`** -- `/bench/home/work/store/user.go:148` -- checks user cache, then calls `s.ListUsers(ctx, find)`
4. **`Store.ListUsers`** -- `/bench/home/work/store/user.go:136` -- delegates to `s.driver.ListUsers(ctx, find)`
5. **`DB.ListUsers`** (sqlite driver) -- `/bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` -- executes SQL query against `user` table, returning rows including `AvatarURL`

The avatar data is stored as a base64 data URI in `user.AvatarURL`. Back in `serveUserAvatar` (line 196), `parseDataURI` decodes the base64 into raw image bytes, which are served via `c.Blob()` (line 209).
